subject: Draft MAP: roles, milestones & target close (please confirm)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Johnson <ari.johnson@openwave.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: roles, milestones & target close (please confirm)

Hi Ari —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good alignment on scope and the primary blockers for procurement. I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) that captures the milestones we discussed, proposed owners, and dependencies. Can you do two quick things for us:

1) Confirm the economic buyer and legal/security owners on your side (I filled in placeholders).
2) Flag any missing dependencies or realistic blocker timelines that would push the target close.

Key items in this draft:
- Target close: 2027-06-30 (proposed)
- Major milestones: SOW sign, Security questionnaire & evidence, Pilot deployment, Performance run + go/no-go
- Redwood responsibilities: provide MAP, pilot plan, SOC2 evidence packet; agree on rollout window
- Customer responsibilities: contract review, security evidence access, internal scheduling for pilot resources

Notes / asks: please confirm who on your side is the security owner (IAM/SOC contact) and legal owner who will handle redlines so we can map approvals in the timeline. I copied Rishi for technical/eng lead questions and Marissa for procurement/pricing alignment.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones & owners).

Thanks — aim to finalize this by EOD Friday if that works.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0167

--
Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (11KB spreadsheet)

From: Ari Johnson <ari.johnson@openwave.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Kumar <samir.kumar@openwave.io>, Dana Lee <dana.lee@openwave.io>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: roles, milestones & target close (please confirm)

Monica —

Appreciate the clear draft. Quick confirmations/changes from our side after a brief sync with Samir and Dana:

- Economic buyer: Ari Johnson (me) — confirmed.
- Security owner: Samir Kumar, CISO (Samir.Kumar@openwave.io) — will lead the questionnaire & evidence requests.
- Legal owner: Dana Lee, General Counsel (dana.lee@openwave.io) — she will do contract redlines.
- Eng lead for the pilot: sending offline — likely Javier Ramos (engineering manager), but Samir will confirm.

Timeline note: Dana said legal will need 10 business days for an initial review once we have a redline-ready SOW. That makes your 2027-06-30 target tight unless we start SOW review this week. Can we compress the pilot technical readiness to a 1-week canary so legal/pricing can progress in parallel?

Also: two dependencies to call out explicitly in the MAP:
- Dedicated test dataset / access to anonymized telemetry (we can get this to you by May 27)
- Whitelisting Redwood IPs for the pilot (network team needs 3 business days once we provide IP ranges)

I reviewed the spreadsheet; I'll mark changes in the attached and return by EOD.

—Ari
Ari Johnson | Director of Data Platforms
OpenWave Analytics
ari.johnson@openwave.io
External: +1 (206) 555-0112

Thanks Ari — quick tech notes from my side to make the pilot and timeline realistic:

- Redwood will assign an Eng Lead (I propose Rahul Sen from the delivery team) to coordinate the pilot. Rahul will own the pilot runbook and be the single point for network/IP & data ingestion setup.
- For the 1-week canary: we can compress the standard 2-week pilot to 5 business days if the following are ready by May 26:
  * Anonymized telemetry dump (customer provides)
  * IP whitelisting completed
  * Test account with sample real traffic routing (minimal SLA)

- Security evidence: we can provide SOC2 in full and a scoped network diagram by May 24. For anything the customer needs beyond that (e.g., pen test artifacts), we can coordinate an exception process but expect additional lead time.

I'll update the MAP with the eng lead and add the specific dates above and send back. If legal needs more time, we should still run the technical canary in parallel so we keep momentum.

-Rishi
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Ari / team —

Thanks for the quick responses. I updated the MAP with the confirmed owners and the compressed technical canary plan (see attached Redwood_MAP_v1_updated.xlsx). High-level updates:

- Economic buyer: Ari Johnson (confirmed)
- Security owner: Samir Kumar (CISO) — assigned in MAP
- Legal owner: Dana Lee (GC) — assigned in MAP; note added: expected 10 business-day review on SOW
- Eng lead (Redwood): Rahul Sen (proposed) — Rishi to confirm supply

Revised tentative timeline:
- May 24: Security packet + network diagram delivered by Redwood
- May 26: Customer provides anonymized telemetry; Redwood provides IP ranges
- May 27–31: 5-day canary pilot (technical run)
- Jun 7: Performance summary & go/no-go decision
- Jun 14–30: Contract finalization window (legal + redlines in parallel)

I also added explicit dependencies cells (data, IP whitelist, legal review) and a decision owner column so approvals are visible. If this looks correct, I'll kick off a DocuSign envelope for the SOW draft and send a HubSpot update (deal DW-6782).

Next steps for Ari: confirm Javier/Rahul as eng lead for your side and confirm acceptance of the target timeline so we can trigger legal.

Thanks — aiming to lock MAP by EOD Monday.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

—Ari
